proof_body:
by
  intro K L _ _ _ _ _
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite K
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite K L
  haveI : Finite L := Module.finite_of_finite K
  refine ⟨FiniteField.frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic K L, ?_, FiniteField.orderOf_frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic K L, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    exact congrFun (FiniteField.coe_frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic K L) x
  · intro σ
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (FiniteField.bijective_frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic_pow K L).2 σ
    exact ⟨n.1, hn.symm⟩
target_source: ∀ (K L : Type*) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Finite K] [FiniteDimensional K L], ∃ φ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (∀ x : L, φ x = x ^ Nat.card K) ∧ orderOf φ = Module.finrank K L ∧ ∀ σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, ∃ i : ℕ, σ = φ ^ i
